branding.headline: Find the 20 hours a month you're losing
branding.subheadline: Four questions. I'll map where AI actually pays off in your business — and where it doesn't. No pitch deck, no retainer talk until it's obvious it's worth it.
branding.thanks_message: Got it. I'm reading this myself, not a bot — expect a specific answer about YOUR bottleneck, not a brochure.

steps.title: First — who am I talking to?
steps.description: Takes about 20 seconds. I read every one of these personally.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Work email
fields.help: Where the audit lands. I don't add anyone to a newsletter.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Mobile number
fields.help: So I can follow up with you personally — I read every one.

fields.name: website
fields.label: Website or social handle
fields.help: Optional — but it lets me look at your actual setup before we speak.

steps.title: Where's the bottleneck right now?
steps.description: Be honest about the messy one — that's usually where the money is.

fields.name: automation_goal
fields.label: What would you most want AI to take off your plate?

options.label: Sales & lead gen — finding and following up with prospects
Customer support — answering the same questions all day
Workflow automation — the manual admin between systems
A custom AI agent fleet — I want the whole operation running itself

fields.name: bottleneck_detail
fields.label: What does that actually look like on a bad week?
fields.placeholder: e.g. leads sit in the inbox for two days because nobody owns follow-up
fields.help: One or two sentences. This is the part I actually use.

fields.name: tried_before
fields.label: Tried to fix it before?

options.label: No — first time looking at this
Yes — built something myself, it half-works
Yes — hired someone, it didn't stick

fields.help: No wrong answer. It tells me what NOT to repeat.

steps.title: How big is the operation?
steps.description: Rough is fine. This decides whether AI pays back in weeks or never — I'll tell you straight if it's the latter.

fields.name: budget
fields.label: Budget set aside for this?

options.label: Nothing yet — exploring what it costs

fields.help: Optional. Skipping it doesn't disqualify you — it just changes what I propose.

steps.title: Last one — when do you want this working?
steps.description: Sets whether I send you the audit or we just get on a call.

options.label: Immediately — it's costing me money right now

fields.name: wants_call
fields.label: Want to skip the back-and-forth and just book a call?

options.label: Send the audit first, then we'll talk

fields.help: Either is fine. The audit is free regardless.
